prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: a towering dark knight in heavy midnight-blue plate armour with gold trim, a full helm crowned with two large curved ivory horns, two glowing red eyes in the visor slit, broad layered pauldrons, a long dark red cape, wielding a broad steel greatsword. FACE: the face is hidden by the horned helm; two glowing red eyes in the visor slit are readable.

Pose: the wind-up of a crushing overhead blow: both hands gripping the greatsword raised high above his horned helm, the blade angled back over his shoulder, chest open toward the heroes, front foot planted forward, cape lifting behind him; he sinks into a deep crouch with both knees bent so that the whole figure, horns and raised blade included, stays inside the grey box at exactly the same pixel size as in Image 3 (the raised blade's tip is the highest point, well below the top of the image), facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso, extend the limbs and weapon far from the body, and let the mantle and loose armour edges fly with the motion. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Limbs, mantle and weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a bare face, a skull, a shield, a second weapon.
